moments.author: Joe Mixon
moments.why: Cryptic hourglass post after trade deadline fuels speculation about NFL comeback.

moments.author: JD Vance
moments.quote: Has Pete Hegseth committed impeachable crimes? The question is absurd …
moments.why: Sharp jab at impeachment theatre resonates amid post-midterms GOP angst.

moments.author: Hakeem Jeffries
moments.quote: House Democrats have won 258 seats … News of our demise was greatly exaggerated.
moments.why: Bold post-midterms claim of Democratic dominance is trending fast among political circles.

moments.author: The White House
moments.quote: From day one, President Trump made homeland security NATIONAL SECURITY. The message is simple: this is our hemisphere. Act accordingly.
moments.why: Strong national security messaging from the administration sparking debate.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: If she’s a 10, you’re an asset … meant to say ‘if your gf is a 10, you’re an asset’
moments.why: Old joke resurfaces as viral meme amid Huang-Nvidia affair, reigniting attention on Musk.
